resolved.title: 指针 Pointer
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Pointers[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

All of the values that we define in our program are stored in the computer memory and have their own unique memory address.

[b]Pointers[/b] are special variables that hold the memory address of values.

In Go, we declare a pointer using a *:[code format="go" ]var p *int [/code]
Now, [b]p[/b] is a pointer to an integer value.
[note][b]Pointers[/b] allow you to pass references to values in your program. We will learn about use cases in coming lessons.[/note]

resolved.title: 指针 Pointer
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Pointers[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

We know how to define a pointer, but how do we assign it a memory address? 
This is done using the [b]& operator,[/b] which returns the memory address of a variable.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]x := 42
p := &x[/code]
Now [b]p[/b] is a pointer and holds the memory address of [b]x[/b].
Let's output its value:[code format="go" codeId="3330"]fmt.Println(p) [/code]
If we want to access the underlying value of a pointer, we can use the [b]* operator[/b]:[code format="go" codeId="3331"]fmt.Println(*p) //42 [/code]
The * operator can also be used to change the value of the memory address the pointer holds:[code format="go" codeId="3332"]x := 42
p := &x

*p = 8
fmt.Println(*p)
fmt.Println(x)[/code]
We were able to change the value of [b]x[/b] using the pointer [b]p[/b].

[note]The * operator is called the [b]dereferencing[/b] operator.[/note]

content.text_html:
We know how to define a pointer, but how do we assign it a memory address? This is done using the & operator, which returns the memory address of a variable.

For example:

我们知道如何定义一个指针，但我们如何给它分配一个内存地址呢？ 这是通过**&操作符完成的，**操作符返回一个变量的内存地址。

例如：

content.text:
现在**p**是一个指针，且值为变量**x**的内存地址。
尝试输出**p**它的值：
content.text_html:
Now p is a pointer and holds the memory address of x. Let's output its value:

现在p是一个指针，持有x的内存地址。 我们来输出它的值。

content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  x := 42
  p := &x
  fmt.Println(p)
}

content.text: 如果想访问一个指针所指向变量的值，可以使用`*`操作符：
content.text_html:
If we want to access the underlying value of a pointer, we can use the *** operator**:

如果我们想访问一个指针的底层值，我们可以使用*操作符。

content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  x := 42
  p := &x
  fmt.Println(*p)
}

content.text: `*`操作符也可以用来改变指针持有的内存地址的值：
content.text_html:
The * operator can also be used to change the value of the memory address the pointer holds:

*操作符也可以用来改变指针持有的内存地址的值。

content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  x := 42
  p := &x

  *p = 8
  fmt.Println(*p)
  fmt.Println(x)
}

content.text: 我们能够使用指针`*p`来改变变量`x`的值。
content.text_html:
We were able to change the value of x using the pointer p.

我们能够使用指针p来改变x的值。

content.text: `*`操作符称为**间接引用**操作符。
content.text_html:
The * operator is called the dereferencing operator.

*操作符被称为递归操作符。
